metadata.description: XAG references the USD spot price of 1 troy ounce of silver. Silver trades as both a precious metal and an industrial input for electronics and solar panels.

BRENT references the USD price of 1 barrel of Brent crude oil, priced off the front-month ICE Brent crude oil futures contract. Ahead of each monthly expiry, the index blends the expiring contract into the next-month contract over a roll window. Brent is the international benchmark grade for seaborne crude.

SPCX references 1 share of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: SPCX), quoted in USD. SpaceX builds and launches rockets and spacecraft and operates the Starlink satellite internet network.

SAMSUNG references 1 share of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. common stock (KRX: 005930), quoted in USD. The share trades in Korean won on the Korea Exchange, and we convert the won price to USD at the USD/KRW spot rate. Samsung Electronics is a South Korean electronics company that makes memory chips, smartphones, displays, and consumer electronics.

BOC references 1 H share of Bank of China Limited (HKEX: 3988), quoted in USD. The share trades in Hong Kong dollars on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, and we convert the HKD price to USD at the USD/HKD spot rate. Bank of China is one of China's four largest state-owned commercial banks, providing corporate, retail, and investment banking and foreign exchange services worldwide.
TSLA references 1 share of Tesla, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: TSLA), quoted in USD. Tesla builds electric vehicles and battery storage systems and develops autonomous driving software and robotics.

US100 references the USD level of the Nasdaq-100 index. The Nasdaq-100 tracks 100 of the largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market, weighted by modified market capitalization. The market tracks the index itself rather than a futures contract, so there is no expiry or roll. The reference price is a 24/7 feed derived from liquid Nasdaq-100-tracking instruments, so it continues to trade outside regular US exchange hours while US stock markets are closed.
INTC references 1 share of Intel Corporation common stock (Nasdaq: INTC), quoted in USD. Intel designs and fabricates CPUs and other semiconductors and runs its own foundry business.

GOOGL references 1 share of Alphabet Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: GOOGL), quoted in USD. Alphabet owns Google and earns most of its revenue from search and video advertising, with cloud and AI as its growth businesses.
DRAM references 1 share of the Roundhill Memory ETF (Cboe BZX: DRAM), quoted in USD. The fund holds companies across the semiconductor memory and storage supply chain.

XIAOMI references 1 Class B share of Xiaomi Corporation (HKEX: 1810), quoted in USD. The share trades in Hong Kong dollars on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, and we convert the HKD price to USD at the USD/HKD spot rate. Xiaomi is a Chinese consumer electronics company that makes smartphones, smart home devices, and electric vehicles.
CHIP references the USD price of 1 CHIP, the governance token of USD.AI. USD.AI is a lending protocol where stablecoin depositors fund loans collateralized by GPUs and other AI hardware.

CRCL references 1 share of Circle Internet Group, Inc. Class A common stock (NYSE: CRCL), quoted in USD. Circle issues the USDC stablecoin and provides payment, settlement, and treasury infrastructure built around it.

META references 1 share of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: META), quoted in USD. Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Threads, and develops AI models and mixed-reality hardware.

SOL references the USD price of 1 SOL, the native asset of the Solana network. Solana is a high-throughput Layer 1 that pairs proof of stake with proof of history, and holders use SOL for gas and staking.
SNDK references 1 share of Sandisk Corporation common stock (Nasdaq: SNDK), quoted in USD. Sandisk, spun out of Western Digital, makes NAND flash memory and consumer and enterprise storage products.
IOVA references 1 share of Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: IOVA), quoted in USD. Iovance sells cell therapies that treat solid tumors with a patient's own immune cells.
PUMP references the USD price of 1 PUMP, the token of Pump.fun. Pump.fun is a Solana memecoin launchpad and trading venue that directs a share of platform fees to PUMP buybacks.
CARDS references the USD price of 1 CARDS, the native token of Collector Crypto. Collector Crypto tokenizes physical trading cards and other collectibles for onchain trading.

NVDA references 1 share of NVIDIA Corporation common stock (Nasdaq: NVDA), quoted in USD. NVIDIA designs GPUs and accelerated computing platforms for AI training and inference, gaming, and data centers.

UNI references the USD price of 1 UNI, the governance token of Uniswap. Uniswap is the largest onchain automated market maker, with protocol versions V1 through V4 deployed on Ethereum and multiple Layer 2s.

INDIA50 references 1 unit of the Nippon India ETF Nifty 50 BeES (NSE: NIFTYBEES), quoted in USD. The ETF tracks the Nifty 50 index of 50 large Indian companies and trades in Indian rupees on the National Stock Exchange of India, and we convert the INR price to USD at the USD/INR spot rate. The price follows the ETF unit rather than the index level.

XRP references the USD price of 1 XRP, the native asset of the XRP Ledger. The XRP Ledger is a payments-focused blockchain launched in 2012, and Ripple Labs uses XRP as a bridge asset in its cross-border settlement products.
XMR references the USD price of 1 XMR, the native asset of the Monero network. Monero is a privacy-focused Layer 1 that hides sender, receiver, and amount on every transaction by default.

SKHYNIX references 1 share of SK hynix Inc. common stock (KRX: 000660), quoted in USD. The share trades in Korean won on the Korea Exchange, and we convert the won price to USD at the USD/KRW spot rate. SK hynix is a South Korean semiconductor company that designs and manufactures memory chips, including DRAM, NAND flash, and high-bandwidth memory (HBM).

BTC references the USD price of 1 bitcoin, the native asset of the Bitcoin network. Bitcoin launched in 2009 as the first proof-of-work blockchain and remains the largest crypto asset by market capitalization.

BYD references 1 H share of BYD Company Limited (HKEX: 1211), quoted in USD. The share trades in Hong Kong dollars on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, and we convert the HKD price to USD at the USD/HKD spot rate. BYD is a Chinese manufacturer of electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, batteries, and electronic components.

CYPH references 1 share of Cypherpunk Technologies Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: CYPH), quoted in USD. Cypherpunk Technologies is a digital asset treasury company that holds Zcash (ZEC) as its primary reserve asset.
LLY references 1 share of Eli Lilly and Company common stock (NYSE: LLY), quoted in USD. Eli Lilly sells pharmaceuticals and is best known for its diabetes, obesity, and oncology drugs.

CRV references the USD price of 1 CRV, the governance token of Curve Finance. Curve is an onchain automated market maker specialized in low-slippage swaps between like-priced assets such as stablecoins, and issues the crvUSD stablecoin.

NEAR references the USD price of 1 NEAR, the native asset of the NEAR Protocol network. NEAR is a proof-of-stake Layer 1 using sharding for scalability, and holders use NEAR for gas, staking, and governance.
LIT references the USD price of 1 LIT, the native token of Lighter. Lighter is a zero-knowledge Layer 2 on Ethereum built for perpetuals and spot trading with a verifiable order book.

USDBRL references the USD/BRL spot exchange rate, the number of Brazilian reais per 1 US dollar. The price rises when the real weakens against the dollar and falls when it strengthens. The Brazilian real is the official currency of Brazil, issued by the Banco Central do Brasil.
HYPE references the USD price of 1 HYPE, the native asset of the Hyperliquid Layer 1. Hyperliquid runs a perpetuals exchange, and holders use HYPE for gas, staking, and fee discounts.

AAPL references 1 share of Apple Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: AAPL), quoted in USD. Apple designs the iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch, and runs services including the App Store, iCloud, and Apple Music.

FLUID references the USD price of 1 FLUID, the governance token of Fluid. Fluid, built by the team behind Instadapp, is a DeFi protocol on Ethereum and other chains that combines lending vaults and a DEX on a shared liquidity layer. FLUID was previously named INST.

USDKRW references the USD/KRW spot exchange rate, the number of South Korean won per 1 US dollar. The price rises when the won weakens against the dollar and falls when it strengthens. The South Korean won is the official currency of South Korea, issued by the Bank of Korea.

US500 references the USD level of the S&P 500 index. The S&P 500 tracks 500 of the largest US-listed companies weighted by float-adjusted market capitalization. The market tracks the index itself rather than a futures contract, so there is no expiry or roll. The reference price is a 24/7 feed derived from liquid S&P 500-tracking instruments, so it continues to trade outside regular US exchange hours while US stock markets are closed.
ETH references the USD price of 1 ether, the native asset of the Ethereum network. Ethereum is a proof-of-stake Layer 1 hosting the largest smart-contract ecosystem.

MRVL references 1 share of Marvell Technology, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: MRVL), quoted in USD. Marvell designs custom silicon, networking, and storage chips for data centers and telecom infrastructure.

MON references the USD price of 1 MON, the native asset of the Monad network. Monad is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 designed for parallel execution and high throughput, and holders use MON for gas and staking.

WTI references the USD price of 1 barrel of West Texas Intermediate crude oil, priced off a synthetic spot built from the two nearest NYMEX WTI crude oil futures contracts. The index shifts weight from the front contract into the next-month contract as expiry approaches. WTI is the benchmark grade for North American crude.

QNT references the USD price of 1 QNT, the utility token of Quant Network. Quant builds Overledger, an interoperability platform that connects different blockchains and enterprise networks, and QNT pays for access to Overledger licenses and services.

SUI references the USD price of 1 SUI, the native asset of the Sui network. Sui is a Layer 1 built on the Move language and an object-centric data model, and holders use SUI for gas, staking, and governance.
AMC references 1 share of AMC Entertainment Holdings, Inc. common stock (NYSE: AMC), quoted in USD. AMC runs a large movie theater chain across the US and Europe.

ZEC references the USD price of 1 ZEC, the native asset of the Zcash network. Zcash is a Bitcoin-derived Layer 1 that uses zero-knowledge proofs to offer shielded transactions alongside transparent ones.
XAUT references the USD price of 1 Tether Gold token. Each XAUT is a claim on one troy ounce of physical gold that Tether holds in custody.
MU references 1 share of Micron Technology, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: MU), quoted in USD. Micron is one of three major DRAM producers and a leading supplier of NAND flash and high-bandwidth memory.
